data.title: Technical Lead  - Java Scala Python Kakfa
data.jd: <p>As a core architectural leader, you will translate business goals into scalable designs balancing performance, cost, modularity, and operational excellence. Collaborate with engineering, infra, and data teams to ensure Accelerate is high-performance, low-latency, and IPO-ready.Architecture &amp; Design: Architect campaign engine, billing orchestration, feedback loop, and reporting. Define microservices, pipelines, event flows (Kafka, gRPC/REST, DDD). Apply SOLID and infra-aware design.Engineering Leadership: Lead design reviews, POCs, failure analysis, scalability sims. Set standards for APIs, schema, contract testing, and compatibility. Mentor backend, data, and DevOps engineers.Reliability &amp; Observability: Implement logs, metrics, tracing, alerts (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Define SLOs, error budgets, automation, and KPIs.FinOps &amp; Infra, Collaboration:Partner with product, finance, SSP/DSP, ERP/CRM for data model accuracy, analytics, and integration.</p>

data.title: Scrum Master
data.jd: <p>The Scrum Master will be a member of the Brightlayer Cloud Team and play a role in this work by driving the delivery of the internal Design System releases and facilitating the related agile processes. This is rapidly growing area of the business, and we are looking the right individual to lead the scrum teams.Drives Continuous Improvement activities to improve collaboration, communication and efficiency in addition to reducing operational wasteCoaches the team on Agile Principles and ensures accountabilityFacilitates all scrum ceremonies including Daily Stand Up, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint RetrospectivesKeeps the team focused on deliverables by working with team manager to remove impedimentsContributes to a positive, productive, fun, and inclusive team environmentIdentifies purposeful metrics and measures team progressWorks closely with Product Owner Scrum Master Certification</p>
